subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to inform you about an important update regarding your upcoming flight. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there has been a change in the departure time. Your new departure time is now scheduled for 2:00 PM instead of the original 1:00 PM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Safe travels! Best regards, [Airline Name]
